name: EmpirioLabs AI
author: EmpirioLabs AI
description: Run 180+ AI models, image, video and speech generation, web search, batch jobs, GPU Cloud and hosted agents as tools with your EmpirioLabs account.

tools.name: list_models
tools.description: List EmpirioLabs models with author, modality, endpoints and final prices. Filter by free-text query, modality (text, image, video, audio, multimodal, 3D), category, author, or endpoint path.

query.description: Free-text filter matched against id, name, author, description, features and aliases.

category.description: Filter by catalog category such as text, image, video, audio, research, transcription, embedding, reranker, 3d, tools.

author.description: Filter by author slug (for example alibaba, deepseek, zhipu).

endpoint.description: Only models that support this endpoint path, for example /v1/chat/completions or /v1/videos/generations.

tools.name: get_model
tools.description: Get one model's full schema: description, endpoints, context window, final prices, notes, and every supported parameter with defaults and ranges.

tools.name: chat
tools.description: Run a chat completion on any EmpirioLabs chat model and return the assistant reply, reasoning (when the model exposes it), tool calls and token usage. Uses credits.

model.description: Chat model id from the catalog, for example `qwen3-7-max`.

messages.description: The conversation so far, as `role` and `content` messages.

temperature.description: Sampling temperature. Lower values give more focused output, higher values more varied output.

max_tokens.description: Maximum number of tokens to generate.

tools.description: Function definitions the model may call, in the OpenAI tools format.

tool_choice.description: How the model uses `tools`: `auto`, `none`, `required`, or an object naming one function.

response_format.description: Constrain the output format on models that advertise structured output. Omit it for normal text. Set `{ "type": "json_object" }` to force a valid JSON object (JSON mode). Set `{ "type": "json_schema", "json_schema": { "name": "...", "strict": true, "schema": { ... } } }` to force output that conforms to a JSON Schema. Support is per model: check the `structured_output` field and the "Structured.

type.description: Output format. `text` (default, unconstrained), `json_object` (any valid JSON object), or `json_schema` (schema-enforced).

json_schema.description: Required when `type` is `json_schema`. Names the schema the output must match.

strict.description: Enforce strict conformance to the schema.

schema.description: A JSON Schema object describing the required output shape.

enable_thinking.description: Enable model reasoning on models that advertise this parameter.

thinking_budget.description: Maximum tokens reserved for model reasoning on models that advertise this parameter.

disable_formatting.description: Return raw upstream response with no server-side formatting.

prompt.description: A single user message to send to the model.

system.description: Optional system prompt prepended to the conversation.

parameters.description: Extra request fields passed through unchanged. Each model's supported parameters, ranges and defaults are listed in its model details.

tools.name: embeddings
tools.description: Create embedding vectors for one or more texts with an embedding model. Uses credits.

input.description: Text to embed, or an array of texts.

parameters.description: Extra request fields passed through unchanged. Each model's supported parameters, ranges and defaults are listed in its model details.

tools.name: rerank
tools.description: Score and reorder documents by relevance to a query with a reranking model. Uses credits.

documents.description: Candidate documents to sort. Max 500 items, each up to 4,000 tokens.

top_n.description: Number of top-ranked documents to return. Defaults to all.

instruct.description: Custom English instruction guiding the sort. Defaults to a Q&A retrieval policy. Pass `"Retrieve semantically similar text."` for similarity sorting.

return_documents.description: When true, return the original document text alongside each result.

parameters.description: Extra request fields passed through unchanged. Each model's supported parameters, ranges and defaults are listed in its model details.

tools.name: decide
tools.description: Answer typed questions about a state with a decision model and return calibrated probabilities instead of generated text. Put text, JSON, images, audio or video in state, then ask yes/no (noul), multiple-choice (choice), ordered-scale (score) or which-function (tool) questions. Each answer includes its probabilities and a confidence value. Uses credits.

model.description: Decision model ID, for example `aplomb-1`. An unknown ID returns `404 model_not_found`.

state.description:
The content to decide about: text, a JSON object, or a JSON array. Put images, audio, or video anywhere inside it as media nodes, for example `{"type": "image", "url": "https://example.com/photo.png"}`.

The state is counted once per request, however many questions refer to it.

anyOf.description: An image, audio clip, or video inside `state`. Send a public `https://` URL in `url`, or the file as base64 in `data` with its MIME type in `mime`.

url.description: Public `https://` URL of the file. Send either `url`, or `data` with `mime`.

anyOf.description: A JSON object. Media nodes can appear at any depth.
A JSON array. Media nodes can appear at any depth.

questions.description: Questions keyed by an ID you choose, 1 to 128 per request. Each question has a `type` (`noul`, `choice`, `score`, or `tool`) and `instructions`. A `choice` question takes `criteria` as an object of option name to description or null, a `score` question takes `criteria` as an array of 2 to 10 ordered levels, and a `tool` question takes `tools`, a list of function definitions.

tools.name: generate_image
tools.description: Generate images from a prompt with an image model. Returns signed output URLs, or a job_id when generation takes longer than the wait. Uses credits.

model.description: Image model id, for example `qwen-image-2-0`. Omit it to use the default image model.

prompt.description: Description of the image to create.

template.description: Optional image template slug. When provided, the canonical prompt blends with your `prompt`, the recommended model is chosen if you don't pass one, and default params merge for any key you didn't set. See `GET /v1/images/templates`.

aspect_ratio.description: Output aspect ratio, for example `1:1` or `16:9`.

resolution.description: Output resolution. The supported values depend on the model.

image.description: Reference image URLs for image-edit mode.

parameters.description: Extra request fields passed through unchanged. Each model's supported parameters, ranges and defaults are listed in its model details.

wait_seconds.description: Seconds to wait for the result before returning a job_id for the running job (default 40, max 50).

tools.name: generate_video
tools.description: Generate a video from a prompt or an image with a video model. Video takes minutes, so the tool returns a job_id for the running job. Uses credits.

model.description: Video model id from the catalog, for example `kling-3-0-turbo`.

prompt.description: Description of the video to create.

template.description: Optional template slug. When provided, the canonical prompt blends with your `prompt`, the recommended model is chosen if you don't pass one, and default params merge for any key you didn't supply. Validation 400s if the chosen model is not in `template.supported_models`. See `GET /v1/videos/templates`.

extend_from.description: Continue a prior video. Pass exactly one of `job_id` (any prior async job from this account) or `video_url` (an http(s) URL to a video). Works with every supported video model; EmpirioLabs handles the model-specific wiring for you.

resolution.description: Output resolution. The supported values depend on the model.

aspect_ratio.description: Output aspect ratio, for example `16:9` or `9:16`.

duration.description: Video length in seconds. The supported values depend on the model.

generate_audio.description: Also create an audio track, on models that support it.

image.description: Reference image URL for image-to-video modes.

image_url.description: Alias for `image`. Accepted on any image-to-video model.

images.description: Multiple input images. On a model that supports reference-to-video, two or more images are treated as reference images; a single image behaves like `image`.

reference_images.description: Reference images for reference-to-video, on models that support it. The subjects are carried into a new scene rather than used as the first frame, so this cannot be combined with `image`. Per-model limits (how many references, and the maximum resolution when references are used) are listed on the model page and in `GET /v1/models/{model}`.

mode.description: Generation mode on models that expose one, for example `t2v`, `i2v`, or `r2v`. Defaults to `auto`, which picks the mode from the inputs you send. See the model page for the values a given model accepts.

parameters.description: Extra request fields passed through unchanged. Each model's supported parameters, ranges and defaults are listed in its model details.

wait_seconds.description: Seconds to wait for the result before returning a job_id for the running job (default 40, max 50).

tools.name: list_generation_templates
tools.description: List curated image and video generation templates (creative effects) with their slug, modality, recommended model and inputs.

model.description: Only return templates whose `supported_models` list contains this model slug.

featured.description: Set to true to filter to featured templates only.

tools.name: get_generation_template
tools.description: Get one generation template by slug, including its prompt guidance, recommended model and default parameters.

slug.description: Template slug from the template list.

tools.name: list_compose_recipes
tools.description: List the Compose recipes that chain script, visuals, voice and music into a finished video, with their modes and inputs.

tools.name: compose_video
tools.description: Create a finished video from a Compose recipe (brief, script, storyboard or edits). Returns a job_id for the running job. Uses credits.

mode.description: `plan` writes a storyboard, `render` produces the video from a storyboard, `edit` changes a rendered video.

brief.description: Topic, product idea, or direction for `mode: "plan"`.

script.description: Optional script text for plan mode.

storyboard.description: Storyboard returned by plan mode and accepted by render mode.

manifest.description: Prior render manifest for edit mode.

edits.description: Scene-level edit instructions for edit mode.

aspect_ratio.description: Output aspect ratio, for example `9:16` or `16:9`.

caption_style.description: Caption style preset for the recipe.

voice.description: Optional voice preset or voice ID for narration.

product_image.description: Optional product reference image (http(s) URL) for recipes that accept one. Pass a URL the service can fetch; this endpoint does not accept file uploads.

face_image.description: Optional presenter / face reference (http(s) URL) for recipes that require one (Talking Head, AI Avatar Explainer, etc.). Pass a URL the service can fetch; this endpoint does not accept file uploads.

character_image_url.description: Optional character reference frame (http(s) URL) for character recipes; it overrides the generated character. URL only, the API does not accept uploads.

gameplay_style.description: Optional gameplay background style when a recipe supports gameplay variants.

video.description: For the Auto Captions recipe (`recipe: "auto-captions"`): the http(s) URL of the video to caption. Send a URL the service can fetch (for example a signed link or any publicly reachable URL). This endpoint does not accept multipart file uploads, so host the file and pass its URL. Aliases: `video_url`, `input_video`.

language.description: Auto Captions: the spoken language of the video, or `auto` to detect it.

translate_to.description: Auto Captions (optional): a target language to add a translation line under each spoken caption. Omit or use `none` for the original language only.

speakers.description: Auto Captions: give each detected speaker its own caption color.

model_overrides.description: Optional per-stage model overrides. Values must be listed in the recipe's model options.

parameters.description: Extra request fields passed through unchanged. Each model's supported parameters, ranges and defaults are listed in its model details.

wait_seconds.description: Seconds to wait for the result before returning a job_id for the running job (default 40, max 50).

tools.name: generate_3d
tools.description: Generate a 3D model from an image with a 3D generation model (for example trellis-2-4b). Returns a job_id for the running job. Uses credits.

anyOf.description: Base64 data URI or inline image bytes.

image_url.description: Alias for `image` when passing a public URL.

resolution.description: Generation resolution. Higher values add detail and take longer.

decimation_target.description: Target face count of the simplified mesh.

remesh.description: Rebuild the mesh topology before export.

response_format.description: Return the asset as a `url` or as inline `b64_json`.

parameters.description: Extra request fields passed through unchanged. Each model's supported parameters, ranges and defaults are listed in its model details.

wait_seconds.description: Seconds to wait for the result before returning a job_id for the running job (default 40, max 50).

tools.name: text_to_speech
tools.description: Synthesize speech from text with a TTS model and voice. Returns a signed audio URL (or inline audio). Uses credits.

input.description: Script / lyrics. Use [S1] / [S2] tags for multi-speaker models.

prompt.description: Music generation models use `prompt` instead of `input`.

voice.description: Voice id available for the chosen model.

output_format.description: Audio file format, for example `mp3` or `wav`.

duration.description: Music generation only; output length in seconds.

parameters.description: Extra request fields passed through unchanged. Each model's supported parameters, ranges and defaults are listed in its model details.

tools.name: list_voices
tools.description: List the voices available for text-to-speech, filterable by model, language, gender or search text.

model.description: TTS model whose voice catalog to return, for example `qwen-audio-3-0-tts`, `inworld-tts-max`, or `gemini-3-8-flash-tts`.

language.description: Filter by language. Qwen Audio 3.0 TTS matches it case-insensitively as a substring of the language name, for example `english`. Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS and Flash-Lite TTS match a BCP-47 locale or its language prefix, for example `fr-CA` or `fr`.

gender.description: Filter by voice gender, for example `female`. Supported by Qwen Audio 3.0 TTS and Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS and Flash-Lite TTS.

tier.description: Filter to voices usable by one tier of a tiered model, for example `flash`. Supported by Qwen Audio 3.0 TTS.

q.description: Free-text search. Qwen Audio 3.0 TTS searches voice id, name, trait, and use case; Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS and Flash-Lite TTS search id, name, accent, persona, context, and description.

pitch.description: Filter by voice pitch: `low`, `medium`, or `high`. Supported by Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS and Flash-Lite TTS.

multilingual.description: `true` returns only the 30 voices that speak every supported language; `false` excludes them. Supported by Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS and Flash-Lite TTS.

tools.name: generate_audio
tools.description: Generate music or sound effects from a prompt with an audio generation model (for example ace-step-1-5-xl). Returns a signed URL or a job_id for the running job. Uses credits.

model.description: Music or sound model id, for example `ace-step-1-5-xl`.

prompt.description: Natural-language description of the audio to generate.

input.description: Script / lyrics for podcast / multi-speaker models.

steps.description: Number of denoising steps. Higher = better quality but slower.

cfg_scale.description: Prompt adherence. Higher = closer to prompt but less creative.

parameters.description: Extra request fields passed through unchanged. Each model's supported parameters, ranges and defaults are listed in its model details.

wait_seconds.description: Seconds to wait for the result before returning a job_id for the running job (default 40, max 50).

tools.name: transcribe_audio
tools.description: Transcribe an audio or video file at an https URL with a speech-to-text model. Returns the transcript or a job_id for the running job. Uses credits.

file_url.description: HTTPS URL of the audio or video file to transcribe.

diarize.description: Label each part of the transcript with its speaker.

smart_format.description: Format punctuation, numbers and dates in the transcript.

parameters.description: Extra request fields passed through unchanged. Each model's supported parameters, ranges and defaults are listed in its model details.

wait_seconds.description: Seconds to wait for the result before returning a job_id for the running job (default 40, max 50).

tools.name: web_search
tools.description: Run a live web search through a search model (for example exa-search, tavily-search, linkup-search). Returns results with titles, URLs and snippets. Uses credits.

model.description: Search model id, for example `tavily-search` or `exa-search`.

parameters.description: Extra request fields passed through unchanged. Each model's supported parameters, ranges and defaults are listed in its model details.

tools.name: web_research
tools.description: Run a multi-step research task with citations (for example tavily-research, exa-research, linkup-deep-search). Takes up to a few minutes. Uses credits.

messages.description: Alternative to `query`; pass a chat-style messages array for multi-turn research.

reasoning_effort.description: How much research to do: `low`, `medium` or `high`.

max_output_tokens.description: Maximum length of the report in tokens.

search_domain_filter.description: Comma-separated domains. Prefix with '-' to exclude. Max 20.

search_recency_filter.description: Only use sources from the last hour, day, week, month or year.

disable_formatting.description: Skip EmpirioLabs Markdown formatting and return the raw upstream payload.

parameters.description: Extra request fields passed through unchanged. Each model's supported parameters, ranges and defaults are listed in its model details.

tools.name: web_answer
tools.description: Get a one-shot answer with citations from a grounded answer model (for example exa-answer). Uses credits.

model.description: Grounded answer model id, for example `exa-answer`.

parameters.description: Extra request fields passed through unchanged. Each model's supported parameters, ranges and defaults are listed in its model details.

tools.name: run_agent_task
tools.description: Start a long-running agent task (for example with the manus model) or send a follow-up message to an existing task. Returns the job_id and the task_id of the agent task. Uses credits.

input.description: Instruction for the agent. For a new task this is the initial prompt; for a follow-up (when `task_id` is set) this is the new message added mid-run.

task_id.description: Optional. When set, the call sends `input` as a follow-up message to this existing task instead of creating a new one.

attachments.description: Files for the agent to work with (any type, audio, video, images, documents, data). Each item is a URL string or an object with url, filename, and mime_type. Files are placed in the agent's workspace before the task starts. Up to 10 files per message.

url.description: Publicly reachable file URL or data URI.

filename.description: Name the agent sees for the file.

agent_profile.description: Capability profile for the task. Manus accepts `standard` (default) for most work, `lite` for quicker, lower-cost tasks, and `max` for the most complex work. A follow-up sent with `task_id` can switch profiles.

disable_formatting.description: Skip the EmpirioLabs Markdown wrapper around the agent run. Aliases `raw`, `passthrough`, `raw_response`.

parameters.description: Extra request fields passed through unchanged. Each model's supported parameters, ranges and defaults are listed in its model details.

wait_seconds.description: Seconds to wait for the result before returning a job_id for the running job (default 40, max 50).

tools.name: get_agent_task
tools.description: Get the status and output of an agent task.

task_id.description: Agent task id returned when the task started.

tools.name: get_agent_task_messages
tools.description: List the messages exchanged during an agent task.

task_id.description: Agent task id returned when the task started.

tools.name: stop_agent_task
tools.description: Stop a running agent task.

task_id.description: Agent task id returned when the task started.

tools.name: analyze_image
tools.description: Ask a question about an image with a vision-capable model and get a text answer. Uses credits.

image_url.description: URL or base64 of the image to analyze.

question.description: What you want to know about the image.

analysis_top_p.description: Nucleus sampling value for the answer.

analysis_seed.description: Random seed for a reproducible answer.

parameters.description: Extra request fields passed through unchanged. Each model's supported parameters, ranges and defaults are listed in its model details.

tools.name: detect_ai_text
tools.description: Classify whether text was written by an AI model (GPTZero). Uses credits.

input.description: Text or document to analyze (max 50,000 chars per document, 50 docs / 15 MB total per request).

multilingual.description: Enable multilingual model (FR / ES on top of EN).

version.description: Detector version. The latest version is used by default.

tools.name: get_account_usage
tools.description: Read the account's current credit balance and recent usage history (model, endpoint, tokens, cost, status).

limit.description: Number of usage events to return.

before.description: Return events created before this timestamp. Use `next_cursor` for pagination.

from.description: Include events created at or after this timestamp.

to.description: Include events created at or before this timestamp.

source.description: Filter events by source: `api` (direct API requests), `playground`, `compose` (Compose video productions), `gpu_cloud` (GPU Cloud rentals), or `hosted_agents` (calls made by a Hosted Agent).

tools.name: upload_batch_file
tools.description: Upload a JSONL file of requests for the Batch API (one {custom_id, method, url, body} object per line). Returns the id of the uploaded file.

tools.name: get_batch_file_content
tools.description: Download the content of a batch input, output, or error file as JSONL text.

file_id.description: Id of a batch input, output or error file.

tools.name: create_batch
tools.description: Start a batch run from an uploaded JSONL file. Each line bills at the batch price when it executes. Uses credits.

input_file_id.description: Id of the uploaded JSONL input file.

endpoint.description: API path every line of the file calls, for example `/v1/chat/completions`.

completion_window.description: Time window for the batch to finish.

metadata.description: Your own key-value labels for the batch.

tools.name: list_batches
tools.description: List the account's batch runs.

tools.name: get_batch
tools.description: Get a batch run's status, counts and output file ids.

batch_id.description: Batch id returned when the batch was created.

tools.name: cancel_batch
tools.description: Cancel a batch run; lines that already executed stay billed.

batch_id.description: Batch id returned when the batch was created.

tools.name: list_jobs
tools.description: List the account's recent asynchronous jobs, newest first.

limit.description: Maximum number of jobs to return.

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Get the status and result of an asynchronous generation job by job_id. Optionally wait up to wait_seconds for it to finish.

job_id.description: Job id returned by a generation request.

wait_seconds.description: Seconds to wait for the result before returning a job_id for the running job (default 40, max 50).

tools.name: cancel_job
tools.description: Cancel a queued or processing job. Completed jobs are returned unchanged.

job_id.description: Job id returned by a generation request.

tools.name: list_gpu_types
tools.description: List the GPU types available to rent with hourly prices, VRAM, and availability.

tools.name: get_gpu_type
tools.description: Get one GPU type by slug.

tools.name: order_gpu_cluster
tools.description: Order a multi-node GPU cluster from a fabric. Creates billable infrastructure charged by the hour.

template.description: Multi-node workload to run on every node.

nodes.description: How many of the offered nodes to reserve. Defaults to all of them.

volume_id.description: Optional object bucket mounted at `/mnt/<name>`, or network volume mounted at `/workspace`, shared by every node.

max_price_hourly.description: Total $/hr you accepted for the size you are ordering. The order is refused above it.

tools.name: list_gpu_clusters
tools.description: List multi-node GPU clusters for distributed training, with node counts, prices and ordering availability.

tools.name: list_gpu_volumes
tools.description: List the account's persistent GPU volumes.

tools.name: create_gpu_volume
tools.description: Create a persistent volume that can be attached to GPU instances. Billable storage.

name.description: Uppercase letters are converted to lowercase before validation.

size_gb.description: Volume size in GB, from 1 to 4,000.

kind.description: workspace saves /workspace on stop and restores it on the next attach. object is an S3-compatible bucket mounted at /mnt/<name> and read in place. network shares /workspace across compatible instances and cluster nodes, with the same returned per-GB rate.

tools.name: get_gpu_volume
tools.description: Get one GPU volume.

tools.name: delete_gpu_volume
tools.description: Delete a GPU volume and everything stored on it.

tools.name: list_gpu_instances
tools.description: List the account's GPU instances with status, GPU type, hourly price and connection details.

tools.name: deploy_gpu_instance
tools.description: Rent a GPU and start a workload on it (a template, a Hugging Face model, or a container image). Creates a billable instance charged by the hour until you destroy it.

volume_id.description: An available volume you own. Its directory is restored into /workspace before startup and saved before stop or destruction.

gpu_slug.description: The GPU type to deploy from the catalog.

hf_id.description: A Hugging Face repo id to serve with vLLM (mode `model`). Set `HF_TOKEN` in `env` for gated repos.

template_slug.description: A curated model or template slug (mode `model` or `template`).

image.description: A CUDA Docker image to run (mode `custom`).

num_gpus.description: Number of GPUs in the machine, one of the GPU's `gpu_counts`; any other value is refused with `invalid_gpu_count` (422). Your current account limit is enforced at deploy and start time.

disk_gb.description: Requested runtime disk in GB (100-300). A value outside the range is set to the nearest limit.

onstart.description: Shell command to run inside the container (mode `custom`). Runs in place of the image's own start command.

min_vram_gb.description: Minimum combined VRAM the box must have, in GB. Used to reject a machine too small for the workload before it is allocated.

name.description: Optional label for the GPU Cloud instance.

tools.name: get_gpu_instance
tools.description: Get one GPU instance's status, endpoints and cost so far.

tools.name: destroy_gpu_instance
tools.description: Destroy a GPU instance and stop its hourly charges. Data on the instance disk is lost unless it is on an attached volume.

tools.name: list_gpu_ssh_keys
tools.description: List the SSH public keys on the account. Any of them can connect to the account's running GPU instances.

tools.name: create_gpu_ssh_key
tools.description: Add an SSH public key to the account so it can connect to any running GPU instance with the instance's ssh.command. Send the public key, or generate: true to have a key pair created and returned once (use that private key with -i for both hosts: ssh -i <key> -o ProxyCommand="ssh -i <key> -p <port> -W %h:%p ssh.empiriolabs.ai" root@gpu-<instance_id>). Never send a private key.

public_key.description: One ssh-ed25519 or ssh-rsa public key (RSA 2048 to 8192 bits), without options or line breaks. A trailing comment is used as the default name. Send this or `generate`, not both.

generate.description: Create a new Ed25519 key pair instead of sending one. The response carries `private_key` once and it is not stored, so save it before you close the response.

name.description: A label for the key. Defaults to the key's comment.

tools.name: delete_gpu_ssh_key
tools.description: Delete an SSH key from the account. It can no longer open new connections to the account's GPU instances.

tools.name: add_gpu_ssh_key
tools.description: Add an SSH public key to the account, prepare SSH on one running GPU instance with it, and return the ssh command to connect. Use this before a first connection to skip the setup wait.

public_key.description: A single-line ssh-ed25519 or ssh-rsa public key, without options or line breaks. RSA keys must be 2048 to 8192 bits.

tools.name: run_gpu_command
tools.description: Run one shell command as root inside a running GPU instance's workload container and return its exit code, stdout and stderr. Use it to install packages, check the GPU with nvidia-smi, run a script, or read logs. Each call starts a fresh shell.

command.description: The shell command to run, up to 16384 bytes.

timeout_seconds.description: Seconds before the command is stopped.

tools.name: gpu_instance_action
tools.description: Stop (pauses hourly compute charges), start, or refresh a GPU instance.

tools.name: gpu_workload_send
tools.description: Send a POST, PUT, PATCH, or DELETE request with a JSON body to the workload running on your GPU instance through the authenticated connect endpoint (https://docs.empiriolabs.ai/gpu-cloud). For example call an LLM server you deployed.

path.description: Path on the workload, for example v1/chat/completions.

tools.name: gpu_workload_get
tools.description: Send a GET request to the workload running on your GPU instance through the authenticated connect endpoint (https://docs.empiriolabs.ai/gpu-cloud). Useful for health checks and reading results.

path.description: Path on the workload, for example v1/models or health.

tools.name: get_hosted_agents_health
tools.description: Check whether the hosted-agents service is available.

tools.name: get_hosted_agent_plans
tools.description: Get the hosted-agent plans, runtime presets and defaults available to the account.

tools.name: list_hosted_agents
tools.description: List the account's hosted agents with status, runtime type, plan and model.

tools.name: create_hosted_agent
tools.description: Create a private hosted agent (OpenClaw or Hermes runtime) on a plan. Creates a billable resource.

default_provider.description: Model provider for the agent. `empirio` uses EmpirioLabs models.

default_model.description: Default model id for the agent.

import_config.description: Existing OpenClaw or Hermes Agent config to import.

tools.name: get_hosted_agent
tools.description: Get one hosted agent's status, configuration and connection details.

tools.name: delete_hosted_agent
tools.description: Destroy a hosted agent, its storage and its channels, and stop its charges.

tools.name: rename_hosted_agent
tools.description: Change a hosted agent's display name.

tools.name: hosted_agent_action
tools.description: Start, stop, restart, or refresh a hosted agent's runtime.

tools.name: message_hosted_agent
tools.description: Send chat messages to a running hosted agent and return its reply. The agent may use its connected tools. Uses credits.

messages.description: Messages to send, as `role` and `content` objects.

tools.name: list_hosted_agent_integrations
tools.description: List the messaging channels and integrations connected to a hosted agent.

tools.name: save_hosted_agent_integration
tools.description: Connect or update a messaging channel or integration (for example telegram, discord, slack) on a hosted agent.

secret.description: Integration secret, API key, token, or webhook credential.

tools.name: disconnect_hosted_agent_integration
tools.description: Disconnect a messaging channel or integration from a hosted agent.

tools.name: set_hosted_agent_channel_behavior
tools.description: Set how a hosted agent behaves on one messaging channel (for example reply rules).

behavior.description: Per-channel chat signal settings. `streaming` controls live reply preview on supported messaging channels, not model API streaming.

reactions.description: Whether the agent sends lightweight processing reactions.

reaction_level.description: How actively the agent uses platform reactions while working.

typing.description: Whether supported platforms should show typing while the agent is working.

read_receipts.description: Whether supported platforms should send read receipts. Telegram bots do not expose read receipts.

streaming.description: Whether supported channels should show live reply previews with platform-native edit or draft preview support where available.

tools.name: set_hosted_agent_model
tools.description: Switch the model or provider a hosted agent uses.

custom_provider.description: Required when provider is custom. The public HTTPS base URL, model, API key, and protocol of your endpoint.

tools.name: set_hosted_agent_access
tools.description: Set the access mode and allow list for who can message a hosted agent on its channels.

kind.description: Optional connected channel kind to update when sent in the JSON body.

allow.description: Per-channel allowlist of messaging IDs, e.g. { "telegram": ["123456"] }.

tools.name: list_hosted_agent_skills
tools.description: List the skills installed on a hosted agent.

tools.name: add_hosted_agent_skill
tools.description: Install a catalog skill (by slug) or a custom skill on a hosted agent.

slug.description: A skill ref (clawhub:, hermes:, ocgit:, or url:).

custom.description: A pasted skill: name plus SKILL.md body.

tools.name: remove_hosted_agent_skill
tools.description: Uninstall a skill from a hosted agent.

tools.name: list_hosted_agent_mcp_connectors
tools.description: List the remote MCP connectors attached to a hosted agent.

tools.name: add_hosted_agent_mcp_connector
tools.description: Attach a remote MCP server to a hosted agent so the agent can use its tools.

name.description: Connector name, unique for the agent.

url.description: A public HTTPS remote MCP server URL.

header_name.description: Optional HTTP header sent to the MCP server, for example `Authorization`.

tool_include.description: Only offer these tool names from the server.

tools.name: remove_hosted_agent_mcp_connector
tools.description: Detach a remote MCP connector from a hosted agent.

tools.name: edit_image
tools.description: Edit an existing image with an instruction using an image-edit model. Returns signed output URLs or a job_id for the running job. Uses credits.

image.description: The https URL of the image to edit.

parameters.description: Extra request fields passed through unchanged. Each model's supported parameters, ranges and defaults are listed in its model details.

wait_seconds.description: Seconds to wait for the result before returning a job_id for the running job (default 40, max 50).

tools.name: get_hosted_agent_stats
tools.description: Get activity counts for a hosted agent.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search the EmpirioLabs model catalog and documentation. Returns result ids: model:<slug> for a model, doc:<page> for a documentation page.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Fetch the full text of a search result by id (model:<slug> or doc:<page>).

id.description: A result id: model:<slug> or doc:<page>.

tools.name: get_platform_status
tools.description: Check whether the EmpirioLabs API and its models are currently up, with per-model availability.

prompts.name: choose_model
prompts.description: Compare EmpirioLabs models for a task and recommend one, with a cheaper fallback and final prices.

prompts.name: research_with_citations
prompts.description: Answer a question from live web research and cite every source.

prompts.name: generate_media
prompts.description: Create an image, video, audio track or 3D asset from a description and return the finished files.

prompts.name: deploy_gpu_workload
prompts.description: Rent a GPU on EmpirioLabs GPU Cloud, start a workload on it and report the endpoints and hourly cost.

prompts.name: spend_report
prompts.description: Summarise the account balance, recent usage and everything that is still running and billing.
